_note: I030b: follow-up to I030 after finding where the flag of the Master's 'Move' entry is set and that the walkthrough does mention moving on (01-in-the-beginning.md, 'Up Above... - Some Final Notes'). Only partial edits of two entries written by I030.

edit.find: - 'Record' is the walkthrough's saving at the Master's Shrine ('go there to heal and save if wanted', 06-dr-leos-lab.md). The 'Move' entry of ChoiceRecordMoveQuitText is not described by the walkthrough (OQ-I030-1).
edit.with: - The Master's menu is the walkthrough's northern square of Up Above: 'The northern square will allow you to save your adventure, as well as move on later in the game' (01-in-the-beginning.md; also 'go there to heal and save if wanted', 06-dr-leos-lab.md). 'Record' is the saving; 'Move' is the later 'move on', added once the Grass Valley chief has handed over the Brown Stone (OQ-I030-1).
